description: A concert organizer has to transport equipment using carts or trolleys. Carts can transport 5 kg/min of equipment and requires 2 workers. Trolleys can transport 7 kg/min of equipment and requires 4 workers. There must be at least 12 trolleys to be used. Additionally, only a maximum of 40% of the transportation can be using trolleys. The organizer has to deliver at a rate of 100 kg/min of equipment. How many of each transportation method should be used to minimize the total number of workers?

CartTransportRate.definition: Equipment transport rate of carts in kilograms per minute

CartWorkersRequired.definition: Number of workers required per cart

TrolleyTransportRate.definition: Equipment transport rate of trolleys in kilograms per minute

TrolleyWorkersRequired.definition: Number of workers required per trolley

MinTrolleys.definition: Minimum number of trolleys to be used

MaxTrolleyTransportPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of transportation that can use trolleys

DeliveryRate.definition: Delivery rate of equipment in kilograms per minute

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of workers required to transport the equipment while meeting the delivery requirements and constraints"

NumberOfCarts.definition: Number of carts used for transporting equipment

NumberOfTrolleys.definition: Number of trolleys used for transporting equipment
